title: scanner cut champion pointer + apply-audit record (v1)
description: FROZEN contract for the scanner-cut champion/challenger slot's decision record (alpha-engine-config-I7826). ONE document shape written to THREE keys by crucible-research/scoring/cut_promotion.py::run_cut_promotion on EVERY weekly evaluation, promote or hold: config/scanner_cut_champion.json (the live pointer, read by scoring/universe_membership.py::live_cut_champion / resolve_feed_cut), config/apply_audit/scanner_cut_champion/{date}.json (immutable dated history) and config/apply_audit/scanner_cut_champion/latest.json (freshness/liveness proxy). One shape rather than a separate pointer schema and audit schema on purpose: the pointer IS the latest decision record, and two shapes would let the two surfaces disagree about what was decided. Written unconditionally because champion-challenger-policy.md §3 forbids silent absence and a genuine outcome rendering identically — a pointer that stops being written must not read as a pointer that decided to hold (the config#2054 lesson, whose fix on the sibling producer-champion slot is config/apply_audit/producer_champion/). Additive-only evolution: consumers MUST tolerate unknown extra fields; any rename or removal, and any new reason_code slug meaning a condition an existing slug already covered, requires a schema_version bump.

generated_at.description: UTC ISO-8601 write time. Distinct from decided_on: a re-run on the same trading day rewrites the same dated key with a later generated_at.

decided_on.description: Trading-day-normalised scanner run date — matches the dated audit key and the cuts leaderboard consulted.

decision.description: promote = the pointer moved this evaluation (champion != champion_before). hold = it did not, for the reason in reason_code. A hold is an OUTCOME and is always written; it is never expressed as the absence of a record.

champion.description: The cut the sector-team feed resolves from until the next evaluation. MUST be a member of scoring/universe_membership.py::PROMOTABLE_CUTS — live_cut_champion() raises on anything else rather than serving the default, because a promotion engine that believes one arm is live while the funnel serves another is the 2026-07-22 drift (alpha-engine-config-I7808).

champion_before.description: The validated champion read at the start of this evaluation, or DEFAULT_CUT_CHAMPION (attractiveness_top_60) when no pointer had ever been written. Equal to champion on every hold.

reason.description: Prose, for the human reconstructing the decision from this artifact alone (principles.md §2.1). Names the horizon, the shortfall, and what holds.

reason_code.description: Machine-readable outcome. 'promoted' is the only value permitted alongside decision='promote'. decision_horizon_immature is the EXPECTED steady state until a 126-session cohort matures for every promotable arm and must not alert; board_defective and decision_horizon_unmeasurable are defects and do. no_promotable_challenger means the SLOT has one promotable arm, so no comparison was possible — it is a registry state, not an evidence state, it is the expected steady value while tech_score_top_60 is observe-only (Brian ruling 2026-08-21, alpha-engine-config-I8060), and it must not alert. Added under schema_version 1 because it names a condition no existing slug covered: every other hold says something about the evidence, and this one says a comparison never happened.

horizon_days.description: The decision horizon, in trading sessions. 126 ≈ 6 months — the shorter of the two horizons matching the scanner's ~1-year objective, so it matures first and 252 serves as the corroborating veto. 21 is STRUCTURALLY EXCLUDED (cut_promotion.py::forbidden_horizons_days, asserted at import): a −0.264 IC at 21 days drove a live change that nine years of history inverted at 126–252 days (alpha-engine-config-I7580), and promoting weekly on that block reproduces the error on a schedule.

primary_metric.description: Each arm is graded against the population it narrowed, never against SPY (alpha-engine-config-I7576). Pinned to the cuts slot's own primary_metric at import.

last_promoted_on.description: decided_on of the most recent promote decision, carried forward across holds. Null until the first promotion. The §5.2 cooldown is measured from it.

leaderboard_key.description: The research/cuts_leaderboard/{date}.json the decision was taken from, so the numbers below can be joined back to their source. Null only when no board was available (reason_code=board_missing).

arms.description: Every PROMOTABLE arm, ALWAYS — including on a hold and including when an arm scored nothing (champion-challenger-policy.md §3: an unscored cycle is recorded as a miss, never omitted). n_dates_scored is the measurability surface: it is 0 at rollout and climbing it past min_dates_for_inference is the precondition for any promotion. `required` names only attractiveness_top_60 because PROMOTABLE_CUTS shrank to it on 2026-08-21 (alpha-engine-config-I8060); tech_score_top_60 remains valid here and records written while it was promotable still validate. OBSERVE-ONLY arms are deliberately NOT carried in this block — this record is about the decision, and their evidence lives on research/cuts_leaderboard/{date}.json, which scores every arm of the slot. The reason string names them so a reader is not left inferring they went away.

present.description: False when the arm had no row on the board at the decision horizon — distinct from a row present with a null metric.

hysteresis.description: The §5.2 parameters this evaluation applied, recorded with the decision so a past record stays interpretable after the registry changes. Source of truth is cut_promotion.py::CUT_PROMOTION_SLOT.

corroborating.description: What the 252-session horizon said. It holds a VETO and never a vote: it can block a promotion the 126 block proposes, never propose one. Null when no comparison reached that stage; 'disagrees': false with a 'note' when the block was absent, immature, or below min_dates_for_inference — an unmeasured gate is reported, never counted as a pass (§5.1).

defect.description: Set when the board could not be honestly interpreted (missing horizons list, no decision-horizon block, duplicate rows for one arm). The record is written FIRST and run_cut_promotion then raises CutPromotionError — a defect must never erase the evidence of itself.
